chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Muawiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever recites Surah Al-Waw (referring to the opening particle often counted as a surah or part of the sequence), Surah Ash-Shams, Surah Al-Layl (when the night covers), Surah Ad-Duha, and Surah Al-Inshirah (Did We not expand for you your breast) in one day or night, nothing would remain in his presence that would not bear witness for him on the Day of Judgment, so much so that his hair, skin, flesh, blood, veins, nerves, bones, and all that the earth carries from him would bear witness.

And the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, will say: I have accepted your testimony for My servant and rewarded you for it. Go with him to My Gardens, wherever he wishes, and give it to him without grudging bestowal, but as a mercy and favor from Me, and a delight for My servant.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Shams, Lail, Duha, and Inshirah together?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s tradition, this hadith emphasizes the profound spiritual efficacy of reciting Surahs Ash-Shams, Al-Layl, Ad-Duha, and Al-Inshirah, promising that every physical component of the reciter will bear witness on the Day of Judgment. This divine acceptance leads to a unique honor where Allah personally invites the believer to choose their abode in Paradise, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the intercessory power of Quranic recitation and the holistic nature of human testimony in the afterlife.
